subject: 英语
topic: Unit 2 Ways to go to school
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】on foot 步行; by bus 乘公交; by bike 骑自行车; by subway 乘地铁; by train 乘火车; by plane 乘飞机; by ship 乘船; slow down 慢下来; stop 停; wait 等; traffic lights 交通灯
【重点句型】How do you come to school? 你怎么来学校？ I come (to school) ... 我……来（学校）。 Don't ... 不要…… Slow down and stop. 慢下来并停下。 I must ... 我必须……
【A Let's talk】Mike: How do you come to school? Amy: I usually come on foot. Mike: I come by bike. Amy: How does Mrs Smith come? Mike: She comes by car.
【Read and write】Different ways to go to school. Some children go by bus. Some go by bike. Some walk on foot. We must stop at a red light, slow down at a yellow light, and go at a green light. Safety first!
key_points: How do you come to school? 你怎么来学校？
I come (to school) ... 我……来（学校）。
Slow down and stop. 慢下来并停下。
